question:
**Select the appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Back up
solution:
The correct answer is "**Defend or support**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The meaning of the given idiom is "**to provide support or the promise of support**."
 
• We use the idiom **"back up"** in a situation where we are assured of support or help from a person or group of people.
 
 
• **Example**: *The local cops assured us **back up__ **in case there was any hindrance to the religious procession.*
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct answer is **option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__**
